SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR.PERSON_ID SUPERVISOR_ID, HR_EMPLOYEE.EMPID, HR_EMPLOYEE.LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(HR_EMPLOYEE.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPTNAME, TO_CHAR(AR_SUPERVISOR.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') CREATE_DATE, HE.LOCAL_NAME CREATED_BY FROM AR_SUPERVISOR, HR_EMPLOYEE, HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR.PERSON_ID = HR_EMPLOYEE.PERSON_ID AND AR_SUPERVISOR.CREATED_BY = HE.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR_EMPLOYEE.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#
(EXISTS( SELECT * FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HR_EMPLOYEE.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR# ) OR HR_EMPLOYEE.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR#)

select a.AR_MONTH, a.empid, a.local_name, a.deptno, a.dept_name, h.email, a.local_name as chinesename, to_char(a.ACTUAL_WORK_DAYS) AS ACTUAL_WORK_DAYS , to_char(a.PAY_ZM_OT_ZS+a.PAY_ZM_OT_SY) AS PAY_ZM_OT_ZS, to_char(a.ZS_CHIDAO_YIXIA+a.SY_CHIDAO_YIXIA) AS ZS_CHIDAO_YIXIA, to_char(a.ZS_ZAOTUI_YIXIA+a.SY_ZAOTUI_YIXIA) AS ZS_ZAOTUI_YIXIA, TO_CHAR(A.KUANGGONG_ZS+a.KUANGGONG_ZS) AS KUANGGONG_ZS, TO_CHAR(A.PAY_ZM_OT_ZS+a.PAY_ZM_OT_SY) AS PAY_ZM_OT_ZS, to_char(a.PAY_PINGSHI_OT_ZS+a.PAY_PINGSHI_OT_ZS) AS PAY_PINGSHI_OT_ZS, TO_CHAR(A.PAY_FADING_OT_ZS_ZJ+a.PAY_FADING_OT_ZS_ZJ) AS PAY_FADING_OT_ZS_ZJ, TO_CHAR(A.ZHOUMO_OT_TIAOXIU) AS ZHOUMO_OT_TIAOXIU, TO_CHAR(A.SHIJIA_ZS+A.SHIJIA_SY) AS SHIJIA_ZS, TO_CHAR(A.SHIYONG_NIANJIA_DAY) AS SHIYONG_NIANJIA_DAY, TO_CHAR(a.SHIYONG_FULI_DAY) AS SHIYONG_FULI_DAY, TO_CHAR(a.CHUCHAI_DAY) AS CHUCHAI_DAY, to_char(a.BINGJIA_ZS+a.BINGJIA_ZS) AS BINGJIA_ZS, to_char(a.HUNJIA_DAY) AS HUNJIA_DAY, to_char(a.CHANJIA_DAY) AS CHANJIA_DAY, to_char(a.SANGJIA_DAY) AS SANGJIA_DAY from ar_summary_lgech a, hr_personal_info h WHERE h.Person_Id = A.PERSON_ID and a.AR_MONTH = #arMonth:VARCHAR#
